preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of strings n in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 8 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string s_i must have a length between 1 and 8.
The total number of strings across all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output binary string must have a length equal to the number of strings n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output binary string must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout[i] == '1' for i in range(n) if any(s[i] == s[j] + s[k] for j in range(n) for k in range(n)))
postconditions.description: The output must correctly indicate which strings can be formed by concatenating two other strings from the list.
